ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: spellsinger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Spellsingers weave magic into music. A war chant makes soldiers fearless, a lullaby drops raiders where they stand, and a good tune keeps the whole colony smiling.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Music is magic. Inspire allies, enthrall enemies, and keep the colony happy.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Why does the colony keep a bard?' 'Have you seen our mood numbers?'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The ultimate support with fantastic quality-of-life utility. Buff allies, put enemies to sleep, and keep moods high between fights. Wants Attunement and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: skald
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Skalds sing on the battlefield, and their songs shake the ground. Their allies fight like heroes; their enemies hear their own dirge.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Battle hymns and thunder chords. A war bard who leads from the front.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The skald's songs are long. The battles he sings about were short.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Front-line support. Keep Battle Hymn up, stun with Thunderous Chord, and drop the Song of Ragnarok on the big fights. Wants Attunement and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: illusionist
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Illusionists weave lies so beautiful the world believes them. Enemies fight for them, guards sleep, and prisoners suddenly decide to join.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Charm, mesmerize and deceive. Turn enemies into friends - temporarily or permanently.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'He's been a pirate for twenty years.' 'And now?' 'Now he's our cook.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Mind control and recruitment. Charm the most dangerous enemy, Mesmerize the rest, and Silver Tongue your prisoners into colonists. Wants Attunement and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: jester
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Jesters treat magic as a joke, and the joke is usually on the enemy. Their spells are random, ridiculous and frequently devastating.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Chaos magic, custard pies and terrible luck - for your enemies, mostly.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Nobody hired the jester. Nobody can remember when he arrived. Nobody can make him leave.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Embrace randomness. Wild Magic and Grand Finale can do anything, Lucky Coin makes allies crit, and the pies never stop. Wants Attunement and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: showman
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everyone likes a good performer. Better at talking, trading and charming.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: muse
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Simply being around you is entertaining. Nearby colonists slowly regain recreation.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: requiem
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your music becomes a weapon: sonic magic hits much harder and resonates through machines.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: grand symphony
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your songs carry further and linger far longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: living legend
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Songs are already being sung about you. Allies nearby in combat always have valor.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: einherjar
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The song is not over. When downed, rise again in a thunderous chord. Once per day.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: war band
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your warband never stops fighting: allies nearby always have valor and a trickle of ward.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: doppelganger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: An illusion takes the hit; you were never there.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: puppeteer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Attackers may be charmed into changing sides mid-swing.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: mastermind
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your illusions reach further and hold far longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: enthrall
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Enemies who come close to you periodically freeze, transfixed.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bakery
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Throw one more pie per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: trickster
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Sometimes your spells come with a bonus round of Wild Magic.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: hijinks
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Banana peel? Trapdoor? Who knows. You simply aren't where the attack lands.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: the house always wins
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Luck is a skill. Huge crit chance and spells often refund themselves.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: pandemonium
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Chaos follows you everywhere: Wild Magic erupts around a random enemy every five seconds in combat.

AbilityDef.label: discordant note
AbilityDef.description: A note so sour it hurts. May leave the target dazed.

AbilityDef.label: song of rest
AbilityDef.description: A gentle melody: allies nearby heal a little and feel rested.

AbilityDef.label: war chant
AbilityDef.description: A thunderous war chant: allies nearby fight braver, harder and steadier.

AbilityDef.label: lullaby
AbilityDef.description: A soft, irresistible lullaby. Enemies in the area fall asleep where they stand.

AbilityDef.label: inspire
AbilityDef.description: Sing a colonist a song made just for them. They gain a random inspiration.

AbilityDef.label: joyful tune
AbilityDef.description: Play a cheerful tune for everyone nearby. Recreation is restored and spirits soar.

AbilityDef.label: sonic boom
AbilityDef.description: Release a deafening blast of sound in front of you.

AbilityDef.label: ballad of heroes
AbilityDef.description: The song of legends. Every ally nearby gains valor, steadiness and a strong ward.

AbilityDef.label: siren's call
AbilityDef.description: Sing a note no one can resist. Enemies in the area stumble toward its center, entranced, and stand there listening.

AbilityDef.label: standing ovation
AbilityDef.description: Give the performance of a lifetime. Every colonist who hears it is struck by inspiration.

AbilityDef.label: echoing notes
AbilityDef.description: Sing five notes that take wing and chase enemies down, ringing in their skulls.

AbilityDef.label: battle hymn
AbilityDef.description: Sing a battle hymn as you fight: for fifteen seconds allies near you gain valor and enemies near you are battered by sound.

AbilityDef.label: thunderous chord
AbilityDef.description: Strike a chord so loud it knocks enemies off their feet.

AbilityDef.label: rallying cry
AbilityDef.description: A cry that snaps allies out of panic and breakdowns, heals them and steels their nerves.

AbilityDef.label: dirge
AbilityDef.description: A funeral song for enemies who aren't dead yet. They weaken and their doom approaches.

AbilityDef.label: song of ragnarok
AbilityDef.description: The end-of-the-world song. Allies become legends - valor, haste, power and wards - while enemies are shattered by sound.

AbilityDef.label: song of the undying
AbilityDef.description: A saga so stirring that death itself waits for the last verse. For thirty seconds, allies around you who fall are pulled back to life.

AbilityDef.label: charm
AbilityDef.description: Charm a single enemy into fighting for you for thirty seconds.

AbilityDef.label: mesmerize
AbilityDef.description: A dazzling display of light and color. Enemies in the area stand transfixed.

AbilityDef.label: mirage
AbilityDef.description: Fold light around yourself. You vanish, and allies nearby become harder to hit.

AbilityDef.label: silver tongue
AbilityDef.description: Talk a prisoner, a downed enemy or a visitor into joining the colony on the spot.

AbilityDef.label: mass domination
AbilityDef.description: Bend every lesser mind in an area to your will for a full minute. Bosses resist.

AbilityDef.label: plagiarize
AbilityDef.description: Reach into someone's mind and take what they know. A large chunk of their best skill's experience becomes yours.

AbilityDef.label: pie in the face
AbilityDef.description: Conjure and throw a custard pie. Humiliating, blinding and mildly concussive.

AbilityDef.label: wild magic
AbilityDef.description: Something happens! Each target nearby suffers - or enjoys - a random magical effect.

AbilityDef.label: lucky coin
AbilityDef.description: Flip an ally a lucky coin. Heads: they crit more and dodge better. Tails: also that.

AbilityDef.label: confetti cannon
AbilityDef.description: A deafening cannon of confetti. Enemies in front are stunned and concussed; it is very festive.

AbilityDef.label: grand finale
AbilityDef.description: The show-stopper. Twenty random magical effects explode over a huge area. Nobody, including the jester, knows what will happen.

AbilityDef.label: banana peels
AbilityDef.description: Scatter conjured banana peels across an area. For fifteen seconds, enemies who walk through keep slipping over.

AbilityDef.label: juggling knives
AbilityDef.description: Juggle three knives around yourself at alarming speed. Anyone who gets close gets cut, and occasionally a custard pie flies out of the act.

li.label: enjoyed a joyful tune
li.description: That song was wonderful. I can't get it out of my head.

HediffDef.label: song of the undying
HediffDef.description: Death waits for the song to end. If this person dies while it plays, they rise again.
